recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not re-add the two ValueSet multiplicity extensions to FHIR core unless Vocab creates a new final decision superseding FHIR-34259.
issue_request: FHIR-26551 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request raised in R4 and applied for R5. It asked for two standard core ValueSet extensions supporting VSD ContentSystemElement.RelationshipBasedContent.MinimumMultiplicity and MaximumMultiplicity.
initial_application: R5 ValueSet/VSDP source history shows the request was initially applied: commit 054eabf311 added multiplicity extension StructureDefinitions and ValueSet-core IG references, and commit c7fbae90f8 renamed the references to the compose.include extension names.
additional_context: FHIR-34259 was a later Published/Persuasive Vocab issue that explicitly removed valueset-compose-include-minimumMultiplicity and valueset-compose-include-maximumMultiplicity after the 2021-11-04 CPG/CQI Value Set Profiles discussion concluded the extensions were not necessary. FHIR-34259 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 6f2d78caec06f47a532cdae610a313b33c476b05.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini keeps ValueSet in the active build, but current core source, the ValueSet-core IG, release5 history artifacts, and the FHIR Extension Pack have no remaining files, references, profile slices, or canonical URLs for the two multiplicity extensions.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive Vocab issue that explicitly removed the two minimum/maximum multiplicity extensions originally requested by FHIR-26551.
Broader ValueSet profile incorporation work that prompted review of VSD-aligned elements but did not require a separate decision for this seed.
